definition: A regularization technique that halts training once performance on a validation set stops improving.
details: Early stopping prevents the model from continuing to fit noise in the training data after it has already learned the generalizable patterns.
story: Think of a hiker descending a foggy hill in the dark, taking small steps and feeling for the steepest way down. Think of it this way: A regularization technique that halts training once performance on a validation set stops improving. And here is the clever part: Early stopping prevents the model from continuing to fit noise in the training data after it has already learned the generalizable patterns. Skill, for a model, is just error pushed down until it is small enough to ignore. And that is Early Stopping — the quiet loop that turns flailing into skill.
